svg.title: Chance comes in bunches
svg.desc: One reproducible simulation of 100 independent fair coin tosses, seed 20261117, read left to right and then down. H means heads; T means tails. All six maximal runs of five or more identical results are highlighted: tosses 5–14 tails, 26–30 tails, 31–39 heads, 47–51 heads, 73–77 tails, and 85–90 tails. The sequence contains 46 heads and 54 tails.
